canonical_surfaces.live_runtime: LIVE-001 ↔ Desktop Commander Remote ↔ Termux services ↔ Android Chrome/CDP
canonical_surfaces.network_transport: cloud-mediated canonical transport; no home-Wi-Fi dependency
canonical_surfaces.ai_council: Connected AI surfaces exchange validated feedback through IMA canonical learning/provenance loop

integration_rule: All new capabilities attach to these canonical surfaces; archives, backups, graveyards, experimental trees and legacy runtimes are historical/non-runtime unless explicitly promoted and verified.
learning_rule: Validated improvements compound only through the canonical loop with provenance, tests, verification, privacy, consent and human-agency safeguards.
ai_learning_rule: Feedback from every connected AI is evidence, not automatic truth: IMA records source, claim, test/verification status and conflicts before promoting a change; connected AIs receive the resulting validated feedback through the same canonical loop.
network_rule: LIVE-001 uses the cloud-mediated canonical transport and must not require the user's home Wi-Fi or a fixed local network.
boot_rule: Android boot starts the canonical IMA live stack through Termux:Boot; Termux services supervise recovery without creating parallel implementations.
archive_policy: Historical preservation is retained; duplicate implementations must not become active runtime paths.
